blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The alleged 20% “commitment” or kickback scheme in infrastructure projects began in 2022 and escalated to 25% during the time of former House Speaker Martin Romualdez. State witness and ex-Public Works engineer Henry Alcantara made this statement to the Sandiganbayan Third Division during the plunder bail hearing of the Leyte lawmaker over a purported P7.44 billion kickback. Alcantara said the alleged commitment rate of former Ako Bicol Rep. Zaldy Co was first made during the House speakership of either Sen. Alan Peter Cayetano or former Rep. Lord Alan Velasco.
